ground_cua

How an answer is judged

ScreenSpotEvaluator — Same as guisyn.

What had to be reconstructed: Same: exact element boxes. The click point in the source is a Gaussian sample inside the box, so the box is used for judging, never that sampled point.

How pairs are filtered

The evaluator above only picks which candidate counts as wrong. Whether that pair is usable is then decided by outside graders that never see the dataset's answer key:

  1. gpt-5.6-luna grades both sides separately. The GT render and the model's render go in as two independent calls, at full resolution, drawn exactly as the reward model will see them. Neither call is told which side it is looking at or that another side exists.
  2. A pair is kept only when the GT grades correct and the model grades incorrect. Nothing assumes the annotation is right.
  3. gpt-5.6-sol re-grades every case where luna said the GT is wrong and the model is right. Only when both graders agree is the prompt removed as an annotation problem; sol overturned a large share of luna's flags, so one grader alone is not enough.
